registration_basis: Bounded historical source/build/session/adapter evidence reviewed before record readiness classification.

evidence.claim: Build registration explicitly ties source commit plus control patch to app10 and APK/catalog declared identifiers. Identifiers were compared as saved strings, not rehashed.
Patch changes build version and MainActivity control/debug/deadline/loading. No change to expanded_probe getNavigatorFeatures/getAutomationFeatures or FieldStatusReporter expressions.

Same synchronous nav reference supplies language and ordered slice languages; automation uses strict-true and grouped fallback. The group can lose original webdriver read if another initial property access throws.
Related field status follows layer/probe failure; navigator and automation groups mapped explicitly.
Parses JSON; preserves web_data object; adds probe statuses and field-status report to per-session payload without language ordering transformations.
Adapter checks exact explicit source state and value aliases, deep-copies values, maps without sort/dedup; quality is derived from source status, not a native raw quality record.
Read only: normalization flattens object keys, treats arrays as leaves, does not sort language arrays; adapter already validates source enum before string preservation.

limits: Not a present-day rebuild or per-device binary attestation; saved build/session/source registration provides limited collection-path support.
language || empty string and languages || empty array erase some falsey original-type distinctions; array slice preserves retained order.
No candidate functions, normalization/equality relation evaluation, old extractor invocation, fit, predict, App, or collection executed.
No new digests computed. Existing raw and run registrations may contain labels/effect facts; only explicit source keys drive checks.
SOURCE_BINDING declares the observed collection path, never the honesty of observed values.
Existing APK/catalog identifiers are saved registration strings; this audit did not hash or rebuild APKs.
No condition or label-dependent source exclusion. Raw absence does not block legacy.
